passages.note: Rivas is listed among the Ayes on the Assembly Floor's concurrence vote that sent AB 1482 to the Governor.

passages.provision_quote: Subject to subdivision (b), an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
passages.note: AB 1482 imposes a new statewide rent cap with listed exemptions, extending coverage to units with no prior statewide cap.

rows.reasoning: Rivas voted Aye on AB 1482 (2019-2020), a single-subject statewide rent cap whose operative section bars rent increases above 5% plus CPI or 10% (whichever is lower) and extends coverage to units with no prior statewide cap, subject to listed exemptions, matching rung 2, 'Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units.'
